$comment: Pinned sources and release assets of the managed schematic runtime. linux-x64 is built from source (Yosys + read_slang + read_uhdm) by toolchain/build-schematic-runtime.sh; darwin-*/win32-x64 are slang-only repacks of OSS CAD Suite by toolchain/repack-oss-cad-suite.sh. Consumed by the extension's runtime manager.

yosys.note: Yosys v0.70 + proc_dlatch memoization (branch v0.70-proc-dlatch-memo); pinned by uhdm2rtlil v0.70.2

surelog.note: v1.87-130; pinned by uhdm2rtlil v0.70.2. Databases from Surelog v1.87 (tag) load in this plugin, and databases from this commit load in the extension's UHDM v1.87 reader (verified both ways)

uhdm.note: v1.87-48; data model = v1.87 plus one appended property (struct_typespec.sign)

ossCadSuite.note: Repacked for the platforms we do not build ourselves (macOS, Windows). linux-x64 is listed only so the repack script can be tested on Linux; users get the from-source Linux runtime above.

darwin-arm64.note: slang-only: Yosys + the slang plugin repacked from the pinned OSS CAD Suite release by toolchain/repack-oss-cad-suite.sh; no read_uhdm

darwin-x64.note: slang-only: Yosys + the slang plugin repacked from the pinned OSS CAD Suite release by toolchain/repack-oss-cad-suite.sh; no read_uhdm

win32-x64.note: slang-only: Yosys + the slang plugin repacked from the pinned OSS CAD Suite release by toolchain/repack-oss-cad-suite.sh; no read_uhdm
